hardware: local box: Apple M3, 8 GB RAM, Python 3.11
local_ceiling: 8 GB RAM; with OS headroom about 5 to 6 GB usable
method: two-point linear fits of each quantity against source lines (and against files) from flask and requests; two points only, so the projection is an order-of-magnitude estimate
purpose: memory and time projection for the django build, made from measured flask and requests numbers BEFORE the django build ran (the project's rule: project peak memory from measured per-unit numbers before a first run at a new scale)
verdict: projected peak resident memory is a few hundred MB, far below the ceiling; the build would fit locally, and runs on Ada as instructed so that its measured numbers also test this extrapolation
